jobs.title: 鸡冠山下游：有水首帧控制的普通水流试片

jobs.prompt_zh: 固定监控机位，只让有水首帧中已经可见的浅灰色或清水带流动：从左下近景沿中央砾石河槽延伸至右侧中景，连续出现沿水道传播的自然涟漪和少量白色泡沫。水面范围接近首帧，不新增分叉、不漫滩。右下白色池岸围成的独立水池、两岸、砾石岛、道路、植被和建筑保持静止。禁止黄色或褐色泥水、泥浆、泥石流、砂砾和石块运动；机位、构图、光照和固定背景不变。一个连续10秒镜头，无移动、变焦、切镜、转场或新增文字。
jobs.prompt_en: Locked-off surveillance camera records the exact reference scene. Animate ONLY the already visible pale gray or clear water band from the lower-left foreground along the center gravel channel to the right middle distance. Coherent downstream ripples and sparse white foam move continuously. Keep water coverage close to the first frame: no new branching or flooding. The lower-right white-lined pond, banks, gravel islands, roads, vegetation and buildings stay stationary. No yellow or brown muddy water, no slurry or debris flow, no moving gravel, rocks or boulders. Preserve the exact camera, framing, lighting and fixed background throughout one uninterrupted 10-second shot. No camera movement, zoom, cuts, transitions or new text.

spatial_controls.scope: Review metadata only. Actual provider input is the clean water-bearing first frame plus text; no regional mask is supported or sent.
